description: This file defines a Css helper class for JavaScript interop within a Blazor application, providing methods to manipulate the body's overflow style.

classes.name: Css
classes.description: A class that facilitates JavaScript interop to control CSS styles, specifically body overflow.

methods.name: ShowBodyOverflow
methods.description: Asynchronously invokes a JavaScript function to show the body's overflow.

methods.name: HideBodyOverflow
methods.description: Asynchronously invokes a JavaScript function to hide the body's overflow and returns a string result.
